title: "Excel parity validation"
---

This page records whether Q-CRAFT (2024-11-15) matches the calculations in its source workbook. The check compares the generated `qcraft` package with excel-grapher's FormulaEvaluator, reading each `compute_*` result from one `Model` per scenario.

Passing parity confirms that `qcraft` reproduces this workbook vintage. Use the methodology page to decide what the paths mean; this page does not grade assumptions or turn scenarios into forecasts.

## What was compared

Each comparison evaluates one workbook cell with excel-grapher's FormulaEvaluator and the same cell through `qcraft` `compute_*`. The check uses the workbook's stored scenario. Microsoft Excel stays closed.

## Re-run

The validation bundle is shipped in the source repository under `tests/`.
Rerun the pipeline `validate` stage after export and annotate. Microsoft Excel is not required.
